description: The modern API client that lives in your terminal.

detail.readme:
Posting

A powerful HTTP client that lives in your terminal.

Posting is an HTTP client, not unlike Postman and Insomnia. As a TUI application, it can be used over SSH and enables efficient keyboard-centric workflows. Your requests are stored locally in simple YAML files, so they're easy to read and version control.

Website · Installation · User guide

Some notable features include: - request tabs, so you can work on several requests at once - "jump mode" navigation - layered environments and variables, with a variables screen and autocompletion - header autocompletion and collection search - syntax highlighting - response search, a collapsible JSON tree, and JSONPath filtering - HTTP, GraphQL, and gRPC, including streaming - server-sent events (SSE), with a live event log and JSON payload inspection - request timing, and a persistent history of responses - customizable keybindings and extensive configuration - 37 built-in themes, plus user-defined themes - open in $EDITOR/$PAGER - import curl commands by pasting them into the URL bar, and export requests as curl commands - import from OpenAPI, Postman and Bruno - a command palette for quickly accessing functionality - `posting remote`, so coding agents like Claude Code and Codex can send requests through the Posting you have open while you watch ## Jump mode Press a shortcut, type a label, and jump straight to any part of the interface. ## Mouse support Click, scroll, select text, and drag to resize panels. ## Explore your responses Search response text, explore JSON as a collapsible tree, and filter it with JSONPath. ## gRPC and GraphQL Send GraphQL queries and work with gRPC services, including interactive streaming.
gRPC streaming GraphQL
## Installation Posting 3 is in beta. It's a single binary written in Go. Install it with Homebrew: ```bash brew install darrenburns/homebrew/posting@beta ``` Or download an archive for macOS, Linux or Windows from the [releases page](https://github.com/darrenburns/posting/releases). Or, with [Go](https://go.dev/dl/) 1.25.5 or newer installed, run: ```bash go install github.com/darrenburns/posting/v3/cmd/posting@latest ``` Now you can run Posting via the command line: ```bash posting ``` Coming from Posting 2? Posting 3 reads the same collections, configuration and `.env` files. See [Coming from Posting 2](https://posting.sh/guide/migrating/) for what's changed. ## Contributing Contributions are welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines. To build Posting 3 from a clone of this repository, run `go build ./cmd/posting`, and run the tests with `go test ./...`. Try gRPC locally with the [example server and collection](examples/grpc/README.md), including an interactive bidirectional streaming walkthrough. Posting 3 is built with [Terma](https://github.com/darrenburns/terma). Posting 2 was built with [Textual](https://github.com/textualize/textual).
